name: color-accent-primary
description: First Light coral. Interface accent: fills, icons, selection tint, focus, large text. Not small text on paper (4.18:1; use accent/text). Never a score, a status or an error.

name: color-accent-text
description: Accent as words (links, small labels) on paper or cards: 5.70:1 light, 8.30:1 dark.

name: color-accent-disabled

name: color-accent-emphasis
description: Accent fill behind small text (the Best tag, stop numbers): accent/onAccent on it is 6.0:1 light, 8.3:1 dark.

name: color-accent-on-accent
description: Text or icon on accent/emphasis (any size) or on accent/primary (icons and large text only: 4.40:1 light).

name: color-focus-ring
description: Keyboard focus ring on custom controls (3:1 or better against the window). Standard controls keep the system ring.

name: color-route-active

name: color-route-inactive

name: color-status-warning

name: color-status-no-forecast
